- Embeddings add-on SKU: engineering confirms availability for GA billing by ~2027-01-03; we can enable a temporary feature flag for evaluation earlier (by Dec 10) if you want to start ingesting sample sets.

1) Ben Carter (Account Lead) — deliver final MAP + XLS with milestones and milestone acceptance criteria (v3 attached). Due: 2026-11-25 EOD.
2) Laura Bennett (Solutions Ops) — confirm integration test window with Anodyne data team and own provisioning schedule (PO -> capacity). Due: 2026-12-06.
3) Marcus Lin (Engineering Liaison) — confirm Embeddings feature-flag window and GA billing date (internal PR/rollout). Due: 2026-12-03.
4) Kimberly Park (Legal) — prepare initial contracting checklist and redline playbook for procurement. Due: 2026-12-08.
5) Caroline / Anodyne Procurement — confirm PO timing and final seat counts for Clinical Insights by 2026-12-05.

Meeting: Proposed MAP checkpoint call — Tue, Dec 1 @ 10:00 PT (30m). HubSpot invite link below. If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Related links: HubSpot MAP (AN-2345), shared MAP spreadsheet (Drive).

I've attached our updated MAP spreadsheet (Anodyne_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a short notes doc. We'll bring a one-page security evidence pack (SOC2 excerpt) to the checkpoint.

Next steps for you: confirm the Dec 1 slot and whether Anodyne wants the engineering sandbox enabled before then (we can toggle the feature flag for test ingestion).

Thanks — Ben
